subject: Townhall — Crescent Hall deposit, PO & cost-center split
messages:
From: Aisha Rahman <aisha@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>, Lisa Ortega <lisa@crescentvenues.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Townhall — Crescent Hall deposit, PO & cost-center split

Hi team,

We're ready to move forward with the Portland Community Lab townhall on Jan 22. Crescent has sent the venue deposit invoice for $7,500 (attached). A few items I need support on so we can get the venue locked: 

- Request: approval to pay the $7,500 deposit and create either a PO or prepayment. Crescent requires deposit to hold the date.
- PCard note: our PCard limit for events is $5,000; this would need a temporary PCard exception or payment via PO/ACH.
- Cost split: recommend cost allocation 70% Field Events (GL 5100) / 30% Community Programs (GL 5012). Please confirm if that mapping works for finance.
- Vendor docs: Crescent requested a W9 and signed SOW; Lisa attached the invoice and said the SOW will be returned signed once payment path is confirmed.

Marissa / Ben — can one of you approve the spend routing and either (a) approve a PCard exception for a one-time $7.5k charge, or (b) issue PO- prefunded payment? If PO, please confirm PO number so I can inform Crescent.

Grace — FYI for logistics budgeting and for vendor ops (AV contact below).

Thanks,
Aisha

--
Aisha Rahman
Field Marketing Lead, Redwood Inference
<aisha@redwood.com>

Attachments: crescent_invoice_7500.pdf (PDF invoice, 1 page)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
Cc: Lisa Ortega <lisa@crescentvenues.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Townhall — Crescent Hall deposit, PO & cost-center split

On Mon, Nov 16, 2026 at 09:12, Aisha Rahman <aisha@redwood.com> wrote:
> We're ready to move forward with the Portland Community Lab townhall on Jan 22. Crescent has sent the venue deposit invoice for $7,500 (attached).

Thanks for the heads-up, Aisha. I can route this, but I need two things before I can sign off:

1) Confirmed GL codes in writing (the 70/30 split you suggested is fine but I need the exact GL strings we will use on the PO).
2) Vendor W9 (Crescent sent a business name but I don't see W9 in the invoice PDF).

If we go the PCard exception route, Ben will have to approve the one-time limit increase since $7.5k > card limit. If PO route, I'll create PO-2026-1187 and pull funds from the Events reserved pool once Ben approves.

Action items for closure:
- Aisha: confirm GL strings (example: 5100-FieldEvents; 5012-CommunityPrograms) and desired split.
- Lisa (Crescent): please attach W9 / signed SOW or indicate when you can supply.
- Ben: can you weigh in on PCard exception vs PO?

I'll queue this once docs are complete.

Regards,
Marissa

--
Marissa Cole
Finance Business Partner, Revenue Marketing
<marissa@redwood.com>
From: Lisa Ortega <lisa@crescentvenues.com>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Acme AV <ops@acmeav.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 08:21:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Townhall — Crescent Hall deposit, PO & cost-center split

Hi Aisha / Marissa,

Thanks — attaching the invoice and the completed W9. We will sign the SOW as soon as payment path is confirmed. We can accept DocuSign for the SOW if that helps speed things up (link below).

Attachment: crescent_invoice_7500.pdf (invoice)
Attachment: crescent_w9_2026.pdf (W9)

We can hold the date for 5 business days after deposit confirmation. Please let me know if you need anything else.

Best,
Lisa Ortega
Director, Business Development
Crescent Venues
lisa@crescentvenues.com
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Aisha Rahman <aisha@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 15:43:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Townhall — Crescent Hall deposit, PO & cost-center split

Marissa / Aisha — confirm approving spend and routing. After reviewing, I approve creating PO-2026-1187 for Crescent Venues for the deposit of $7,500. Notes: 

- Cost split approved: 70% GL 5100-FieldEvents, 30% GL 5012-CommunityPrograms. Please include the split on the PO lines.
- PCard exception not needed since we're using a PO.
- Marissa: please attach the vendor W9 to the PO file and route the PO to Lisa.
- Aisha / Grace: once PO is sent and vendor confirms receipt, proceed with booking vendors (Acme AV for basic A/V; Aisha please confirm final AV spend and submit expense/PCard reconciliation for any on-site incidentals under $500).

I'll mark this as approved in the finance system and log under event spend for Q1 planning.

Thanks,
Ben

--
Ben Carter
Director, Revenue Ops, Redwood Inference
<ben@redwood.com>

Forwarded-For-Record: PO created in the system as PO-2026-1187 (please reference in invoice remittance).
